home.about:
SONNI Group Advisory is a pan-African advisory firm dedicated to
strategy, intelligence, influence and investment. We support governments, institutions, embassies, companies and leaders in
designing and implementing high-impact strategies, combining vision,
expertise and a strong continental network.
With an integrated approach rooted in a deep understanding of the continent,
SONNI Group Advisory builds tailored solutions in strategy, business
diplomacy, institutional communication, leadership and investment
development.
Our mission: to strengthen African influence, support public and private
transformation and create connections that generate long-term value.
home.ceo:
SONNI Group Advisory was born from a simple conviction: Africa needs
platforms of intelligence, influence and investment capable of carrying an
ambitious vision for the continent.
Our firm combines strategic expertise, in-depth understanding of African
dynamics, analytical capacity, diplomatic relations, innovation,
communication and leadership. SONNI is more than a company: it is a
mission.
A mission of transformation, African integration, economic diplomacy and
support to institutions and leaders.
Through our poles, events and programs, we help build a stronger, better connected, more influential and more competitive Africa.
home.ceo_sub: Welcome to the SONNI universe - Think, Influence, Invest, Transform.
home.reference:
SONNI Group Advisory works with public institutions, embassies, regional
organisations, companies and leaders across Africa.
home.reference_sub:
These references reflect the quality of our assignments, the trust placed in
our firm and our commitment to excellence.
